name: A Bathing Ape
why: Streetwear — hoodies, tees, sneakers — with camouflage prints and an ape logo, sold in its own stores.
origin: Founded in Tokyo in 1993 by Nigo; sold to I.T Group of Hong Kong in 2011.

onething.n: verified — direct product page, $569. The full-face zip hood is the brand's whole signature; the BAPE STA sits in the shoe slot rather than competing here

notes.street: one of the founding houses of the register rather than a participant in it
notes.status: logo and camo are the point; the garment is a carrier for both
notes.shoes: the BAPE STA is a core line, not an accessory to the clothing
notes.cotton: heavy cotton fleece and jersey carry almost the whole range
notes.reach: Eight own stores in seven cities, no independent stockists on the register, no department-store presence: selective distribution, found by people who already know where to look. Was a 4 on an inherited guess; reset 23 Sep 2026. [authored findability score was 2; retired 28 Sep 2026]
notes.whitet: sells a tee as a basic (price pass); not read for more — seeded 27 Sep 2026, provisional
notes.logo: Camouflage, the ape head and the shark hood; the marks are the garments.
